ICS 13.040.30CHD 32Reaffirmed 20181. Scope1.1 This standard (Part I) prescribes a method for the collection and measurement of dust fall rates.1.2 Other Analysis Soluble and insoluble deposits are subjected to analysis for ions, elements, inorganic and organic compounds. These additional analysis have been used in source apportionment stud ies.2. ReferencesThe standards listed below contain provisions which through reference in this text constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standlirds are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below:1070: 1992 Reagent grade water (third revision)4167: 1980 Glossary of terms relating to air pollution (first revision)
